profile.device_cycle_timing_scope: whole GPU execution region; individual iteration times unavailable

telemetry.notes: CPU/RSS sampled at 100ms; GPU at 200ms. Unmeasured counters are null.

gpu_occupations.scope: explicit occupation bridge copies; host exports remain

gpu_matrix_assembly.scope: sparse H upload each diagonalization; geometry-owned S/topology/k data; no matrix downloads

frozen_potential_probe.scope: Experimental common-generator frozen exchange with fixed full offsite SOC; band differences, not full-SCF total energies

gpu_hartree.scope: periodic FP64 Hartree; temporary density upload and potential/scalar exports; plan allocations excluded

gpu_grid_flow.scope: resident SCF density-to-potential arrays; temporary 224-byte result export; plan allocations excluded

gpu_sparse_state.scope: owned sparse H/D/E; temporary 144-byte scalar summary and 4-byte mixer status; final array exports

gpu_device_cycle.scope: whole electronic cycles and explicit terminal exports; no individual iteration timings

tables.scope: immutable two-center tables; execution/status in shared integral-force publication

pairs.scope: pre-SCF orbital-pair geometry shared by kinetic and overlap retained-D/E consumers

nonlocal.scope: prepared nonlocal geometry held until authoritative shared force publication

nonlocal_h0.scope: Nonlocal H0 device owner; optional upstream matrix comparison; integrals retained through authoritative forces

residency.steady_state_definition: entire electronic cycle including the first accepted iteration
